say:1:1033420001:1.text: I thought it was for the safety of the forest.
say:1:1033420001:1.source_cn: 我一直以为封锁令是为了保护丛林。
say:1:1033420001:1.male: I thought it was for the safety of the forest.
say:1:1033420001:1.female: I thought it was for the safety of the forest.

say:2:1033420002:1.text: We obeyed Eomir and did all we could to keep the outsiders out in order to protect our forest.
say:2:1033420002:1.source_cn: 我们听命于伊米尔，努力地驱赶难民，将外人隔离于丛林之外...
say:2:1033420002:1.male: We obeyed Eomir and did all we could to keep the outsiders out in order to protect our forest.
say:2:1033420002:1.female: We obeyed Eomir and did all we could to keep the outsiders out in order to protect our forest.

say:3:1033420003:1.text: The irony is, the rose's thorns, meant for protection, turned out to be its own source of harm...
say:3:1033420003:1.source_cn: 可没想到，玫瑰的刺没有保护玫瑰，反而伤害了它……
say:3:1033420003:1.male: The irony is, the rose's thorns, meant for protection, turned out to be its own source of harm...
say:3:1033420003:1.female: The irony is, the rose's thorns, meant for protection, turned out to be its own source of harm...
